answer: An inlet node samples each agent’s text stream, computes a stylometric entropy vector over a sliding window, and compares it to a dynamic juniper‑shaped clustering frontier that wanders as new genuine signatures arrive; any identity whose entropy deviates beyond the frontier is flagged and throttled. To forge N fake identities the attacker must train N independent language models, each costing at least 0.5 ETH in compute deposits locked for 48 hours per identity, plus the forfeiture of the deposit if the fingerprint is detected.
